newsitem.title: USA: Wackenhut Corrections gets Louisiana pact.
newsitem.headline: Wackenhut Corrections gets Louisiana pact.

text.p: Wackenhut Corrections Corp said it has received a Louisiana Department of Corrections contract for the development and management of a 276-bed facility for male juveniles to be constructed in LaSalle Parish, Louisiana.
It will hold minimum through maximum security juvenile prisoners, the company said.
Wackenhut said the company will build and finance a $15 million facility in Jena, Louisiana, for completion in during the second quarter of 1998, the company said.
The company anticipates revenues of $6 million for the initial year of occupancy, with subsequent years subject to consumer price index increases, the company said.

Wackenhut will employ approximately 120 people at the site, and in addition to security and rehabilitation programs, the company will also provide recreation, health and food services, Wackenhut said.
